Tess (AE): Heads up  RapidMed wants to start the POC but procurement is insisting on a wet-ink original Order Form before provisioning. They're blocking access.

Mark (Procurement): Do they accept a notarized scan as interim? If so we can route billing sooner. Need PO to match invoices.

Tess (AE): PO RM-33421. They said notarized scan OK only if the original is mailed and on file within 7 business days.

Rae (Legal): Hybrid flow fine. Proposed steps: (1) send DocuSign to get our countersignature now; (2) accept notarized scan for invoicing; (3) require original mailed within 7 business days. Add attestation to Order Form footer: 

``
A scanned or notarized copy of a manually executed Order Form shall be deemed an original for purposes of contract formation and invoicing.
``

Rae (Legal): Also include DPA reference line: "Data processing governed by Exhibit C (DPA), incorporated herein." I can add both to the envelope.

Owen (Finance): With PO RM-33421 and a notarized scan we can issue invoice Net30. If original doesn't arrive within 7 business days Finance may withhold payment. Need remittance address on the Order Form.

Tess (AE): Uploaded Order Form & SOC2 link: https://secure.redwood.company/attachments/rapidmed-poc-of.pdf and https://secure.redwood.company/soc2/rapidmed-2025?token=REDACTED

DocuSignBot: Envelope env_7d3e created for RapidMed  recipients: RapidMed Procurement, Tess (AE), Rae (Legal). Status: awaiting signatures.

Mark (Procurement): Mail originals to: RapidMed Inc, Attn: Contracts, 120 Tech Park, Cambridge, MA 02139. Include cover letter with PO RM-33421.

Tess (AE): I'll overnight the wet-ink original today and post tracking. Will attach notarized scan when they return it. Will ping @Rae and @Owen when scan arrives. Thanks :thumbsup:
